comments.author: SiulSC
comments.body_html:
I have an idea. Get a drum mag (idgas about which one) and shorten the length (and possibly the width) of it so it fits with 9x39. You can easily do it in blender and you could reposition the patron bones the way you want and test it. You could also make custom textures if you wanna get more into it. Make sure that the width is good along with the bone placement of the patrons, sometimes the rounds can clip out of the mag. Just a thought for the custom bundle.

Edit: DM me if you need help

comments.author: MusicManiac
comments.body_html:
I am not interested in doing any models myself.
Drum mag for val with custom model already exists in another mod that’s linked in description.

comments.author: SiulSC
comments.body_html: It would definitely be great practice in making models and textures. You should try looking at some 3d models of mags use them for the custom model, it would be even better if the mags had textures with no overlapping. It isn’t hard to do, there’s a lot of things you can do. There aren’t many people willing to do this kind of stuff, so it’s definitely good to learn it yourself. It took me 3 days to figure out how to do this stuff, so it’s definitely not hard.
